title: 边缘AI与量子安全重塑云基础设施，AI代理与数据治理成为竞争焦点
core_insight: 云厂商正加速边缘AI基础设施布局以支持主权AI需求，同时量子安全时间表提前至2029年，而AI代理工作流优化和数据安全治理成为各厂商差异化竞争的核心领域

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出ECS Managed Daemons提升容器编排运维效率；Google Cloud推出QueryData工具将自然语言查询转换为数据库查询；Cloudflare Workflows新增可视化流程图功能优化开发体验 AWS发布S3 Files功能使S3存储桶可作为高性能文件系统访问；Google Cloud默认开启基础AI和云安全功能；Cloudflare通过BPF字节码自动化生成恶意软件触发包提升安全分析效率 Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems QueryData helps agents turn natural language into queries for AlloyDB, Cloud SQL and Spanner How we use Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) to turn Workflows code into visual diagrams Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances Raising the security baseline: Essential AI and cloud security now on by default From bytecode to bytes: automated magic packet generation What’s new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 微软与Armada合作推出Azure Local on Galleon模块化数据中心，实现边缘主权AI部署；AWS推出可持续性控制台整合碳排放报告；Cloudflare网络容量突破500Tbps 模块化数据中心模式改变传统算力部署方式，支持离线环境AI工作负载，显示边缘计算基础设施重大演进 Building sovereign AI at the edge: Microsoft and Armada collaborate to deliver Azure Local on Galleon modular datacenters 500 Tbps of capacity: 16 years of scaling our global network Announcing the AWS Sustainability console: Programmatic access, configurable CSV reports, and Scope 1–3 reporting in one place
